Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. San Diego man secures life insurance coverage after being denied due to homosexuality 2. Philadelphia school board hears council about teaching nondiscrimination for gay students 3. Alexandria, Virginia city council postpones voting on a gay rights measure indefinitely COMMERCIAL: Stamp Out AIDS featuring Jennifer Bassey 4. Vermont man "cured" of being homosexual carries a 50 lb. cross across the state 5. Andy Humm on the state of politics with a Democrat-controlled Senate COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 6. London, Education Secretary upset with educational book about a child with homosexual parents, calling it "homosexual propaganda" 7. Study shows being bitten or scratched by AIDS patient carries little chance of spreading the virus 8. Early testing shows three new AIDS drugs block spread of virus without side effects of AZT 9. Circumcision rate for US males sharply declines COMMERCIAL: GCN pledge drive, with clips from the year's news 9. Sports Report, interview with Tom Hansen, commissioner of MCAA Bowling COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 10. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Interview with the director of "The Decline of the American Empire," Denys Arcand COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 2. "Just Ask Raz" advice segment COMMERCIAL: The Monster 3. Coverage of the Christopher Street Halloween Parade COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation with Jose Sarria 4. Interview with calendar model, Andre Fiset 5. Closing credits
